meta.rule: A flaw must cost something in play every session or the GM refuses it.
meta.note: General disadvantages (24) plus race/gender/class sets. cp 'intensity' = CP equals chosen intensity 1-5. 'area' = same-area rule (only the highest pays). 'hook' = when the GM brings it into play.

lost_fingers.name: Lost Fingers (2, off-hand)
lost_fingers.description: Two fingers of the off hand gone.
lost_fingers.hook: every fight with two-handers or shields

situational: grip contests use one arm only

levels.3: no long rest without lock and watch; WIL test to trust allies
levels.4: sees plots in allies; refuses shared food
levels.5: hears plots, may attack a 'traitor' (GM picks, 1/session)

situational: WIL test or attack when insulted or struck first

old_debt.name: Old Debt / Oath-Bound

situational: owes money or service; GM calls it in

old_debt.description: CP 1-3 by size of the debt (GM sets).
old_debt.gm_note: Owner-confirmed: the GM sets the size of the debt (1-3 CP).

nemesis.name: Nemesis

levels.1: a petty local (bailiff's son, rival hunter): spoils deals, lies, 1 in 4 sessions
levels.2: guild master or veteran sellsword with friends: ambush with 3-4 men, bribes guards
levels.3: minor noble, cult cell or Order inquisitor: bounty posted, agents in every town
levels.4: count, Archon or sorceress coven: armies, assassins, can outlaw you
levels.5: final-boss tier (a Templar Ascendant, a Veil-born, an elder): will find you; kill him and his heir takes over at intensity 3

nemesis.hook: I1 every few sessions, I3 most sessions, I5 every session
nemesis.description: Replaces Hunted. Who wants you, and how big they are.

scarred.name: Scarred / Disfigured

levels.1: small but clear face scar, seen in conversation
levels.2: broken nose, torn ear, cheek slash; always seen
levels.3: half the face burned or ripped; children stare, prices +20%
levels.4: melted face, missing nose or lips; treated as cursed
levels.5: 'burned alive and spat back by hell': outcast, must veil/hood 24/7 like a leper; covering counts as I2 but guards and priests demand faces, unveiling = I5 reaction plus 'liar'

scarred.hook: every social scene where the face is seen
scarred.description: Replaces Ugly Scarring. No physical penalty, only social. Looks -0/-1/-2/-3/-4 once the Looks stat exists (until then Charisma tests). Reactions: rules/creation/social_reactions.json.

alcoholic.name: Alcoholic

levels.3: several drinks a day, drunk often

alcoholic.description: Need: I1 one dose a day, I3 several, I5 constant. Withdrawal clock: rules/creation/addiction.json.

drug_addict.name: Drug Addict
drug_addict.description: Poppy, black lotus or Veil-dust. Need: I1 one dose a day, I3 several, I5 constant. Withdrawal clock: rules/creation/addiction.json. Veil-dust adds +1 corruption per dose.

breakdowns.name: Breakdowns
breakdowns.description: Trauma episodes. Pick triggers at creation (blood, fire, screaming children...). At a trigger: WIL test at -0/-5/-10/-15/-20; failure = 1d3 rounds frozen/weeping/raging + stress. I5 starts every session at +10 stress.

phobia.name: Phobia
phobia.hook: every time the fear shows up
phobia.description: Fire, deep water, the dead or enclosed spaces: WIL test or flee/freeze.

bad_reputation.name: Bad Reputation
bad_reputation.description: -5/-10/-15 reputation in one faction; prices and guards.

branded_criminal.name: Branded Criminal
branded_criminal.hook: every guard or court in that realm
branded_criminal.description: Visible brand; the law of the branding realm is hostile.

honour_bound.name: Honour-Bound
honour_bound.hook: every time a lie or ambush would help
honour_bound.description: Cannot lie, strike from behind or refuse a duel.

dependant.name: Dependant
dependant.description: A child, sibling or old parent to protect; the GM threatens them.

illiterate.name: Illiterate & Ignorant of the Faith
illiterate.hook: every letter, map, scroll or priest

plague_survivor.name: Plague Survivor
plague_survivor.description: Plague scars: counts as Scarred intensity 1 for reactions.

vanity.name: Vanity
vanity.description: WIL test to accept being dirty or scarred; stress on failure.

cannot_mask.name: Cannot Mask
cannot_mask.description: No Veil glamour to hide scars.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.description: Must take revenge on a named wrong.

ogre_hunger.name: Hunger
ogre_hunger.description: Ties to the existing hunger_risk tag; higher intensity = more often hunger rage.

witch_hunted.name: Witch-Hunted
witch_hunted.description: Templars and Holy Judges suspect you.
